Name: Milf Interface
Author: Senpai47
Description:
Este é um mod que muda interface geral do jogo, ele é a junção de 2 mods já existentes, Starry Blue e Citrus Interface, (tiveram uns desentendimentos em qual usar no modpack, então eu fundi eles 👍). Recomendo que você experimente o nosso modpack que junta dois grandes mods e diversos outros para completar a sua gameplay.

This is a mod that changes the game's general interface, it's a combination of 2 existing mods, Starry Blue and Citrus Interface, (there were some disagreements on which one to use in the modpack, so I combined something 👍). I recommend that you try our modpack that brings together two great mods and several others to complete your gameplay.

This mod was made by me for friends, so don't expect too much commitment with new compatibility updates and features.
